text:
Predicates:
Romance(x) ::: x is a Romance language.
IndoEuropean(x) ::: x is an Indo-European language.
LanguageFamily(x) ::: x is a language family.
Related(x, y) ::: x is related to y.
FOL ::: All Romance languages are Indo-European languages.
FOL ::: The Romance languages are a language family.
FOL ::: All languages within a language family are related to each other.
FOL ::: French and Spanish are both Romance languages.
FOL ::: German is related to Spanish.
FOL ::: Basque is not related to any other language.
Premises:
∀x (Romance(x) → IndoEuropean(x)) ::: All Romance languages are Indo-European languages.
LanguageFamily(romance) ::: The Romance languages are a language family.
∀x ∀y ((LanguageFamily(f) ∧ Romance(x) ∧ Romance(y)) → Related(x, y)) ::: All languages within a language family are related to each other.
Romance(french) ∧ Romance(spanish) ::: French and Spanish are both Romance languages.
Related(german, spanish) ::: German is related to Spanish.
∀x (x ≠ basque → ¬Related(basque, x)) ::: Basque is not related to any other language.
Conclusion:
Romance(basque) ::: Basque is a Romance language.
